definitions.gloss: entering employment; starting a job; joining a workplace
definitions.explanation: The act of beginning work at a company, hospital, or other organization. Used particularly in healthcare and public-sector contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧{入職|にゅうしょく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧です。
examples.english: I'm a new employee who joined this year.

examples.japanese: {入職|にゅうしょく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Training begins right after starting the job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入職|にゅうしょく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: It's already been five years since I started working at the hospital as a nurse.

notes:
Composed of {入|にゅう} (to enter) + ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (employment, job). While ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧ is used for joining a private company, {入職|にゅうしょく} is a more general term used especially in healthcare (hospitals, nursing homes), government, and educational institutions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入職|にゅうしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to start a job, to join a workplace
- {入職|にゅうしょく}{日|び} — start date of employment
- {入職|にゅうしょく}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ — at the time of joining
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{入職|にゅうしょく}{者|しゃ} — newly hired employee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧ — joining a company; specifically for private companies
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧ — getting a job, finding employment; the broader process of obtaining work
- ⟦{着任|ちゃくにん}→着任：14905_chakunin⟧ — taking up a post; more formal, used for appointed positions
